meta.name: understand-figma
meta.description: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 Figma 文件并生成交互式设计知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 Figma 设计稿中提取结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Figma files and generate an interactive design knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to extract structured information from Figma designs

howto.what: 给它一个 Figma 文件链接或 key,它会通过 Figma REST API 读取该文件,生成一份交互式设计知识图谱(页面、界面、组件、实例、设计令牌等),并在 kind:"design" 仪表盘里打开。
howto.when: 当你调用 /understand-figma 并给出 Figma 文件链接或 key 时接管。需已设置 FIGMA_TOKEN 环境变量,缺失时它会停下提示你先设置,并会说明本次要访问 api.figma.com。

say.note: 用文件 key 指定文件,中文输出

say.text: 用 UNDERSTAND_FIGMA_FORCE=1 重新生成这个设计图谱
say.note: 忽略 UP_TO_DATE,做一次完整重建

howto.what_en: Given a Figma file URL or key, it reads the file via the Figma REST API and builds an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, instances, design tokens) opened in a kind:"design" dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /understand-figma with a Figma file link or key. A FIGMA_TOKEN environment variable must be set; if missing, the skill stops and asks you to set one.

say_en.note: Scans that file and builds the design graph
Uses the file key and outputs in Chinese
Forces a full rebuild, ignoring UP_TO_DATE
